body.statement: If \(K,O\in\mathfrak G_p\) and \(d_K(i)\ne d_O(i)\) for some \(i\in V\), then the precision Jacobians \(J_K\) and \(J_O\) represent different Jacobian matroids.

source.locator: Theorem 4.5 (Outdegree theorem), pages 12--13 of arXiv version 1

attestation.note: Checked directly against the primary arXiv version 1 PDF, page 12; this node specializes the published theorem to the frozen noncomplete simple-orientation class.
